about: A Zork II style underground adventure. You start in a barrow, cross a cavern and formal garden, solve the riddle door, ride a magic well bucket to a mad tea party, and are pestered by a spell-casting Wizard. Several routes (carousel exits, a ledge, rockfalls) are blocked "for now", so it feels like one section of a larger game.

done.why: The 150-turn limit ran out while I waited for the well bucket. It never came back down after I left it at the top, so I was stuck below.

moments.note: Turning on the lamp summoned the Wizard, who cast Feeble and made me drop it.
Exits did not match the room text. North from the gazebo area led to the Dark Tunnel, and the grue and a convention of wizards appeared in the garden.
Reading the newspaper made the odd room settle down. The riddle answer (a well) opened the stone door.
The well bucket puzzle worked. Water in the bucket made it rise to the top of the well.
I ate the red cake with no water and died. I lost all my items, including the teapot.
The carousel scrambles every exit. Getting anywhere took many tries.
The bucket never came back down, so I could not reach the top of the well or the tea room again.

wished: Know which cake was safe, or have a hint that the red cake needs water.
Get past the rockfalls and the ledge.
Find out what the unicorn's key opens.

lines.line: He peers at you from under his bushy eyebrows, as though you were not at all what he had been expecting, and had turned up anyway.
lines.why: Funny, and it set the tone for the Wizard.

lines.line: It is a wooden bucket, 3 feet across and 3 feet high... that is the whole art of buckets.
lines.why: A charming description that also hints at how the puzzle works.

lines.line: That was delicious, but your dying memory is of feeling horribly dehydrated and thirsty.
lines.why: A good death message that hinted at the fix.

fun.why: Good puzzles and wit, but the carousel and the stuck bucket made it a slog.

engagement.why: I was curious to explore, but the blocked paths limited where I could go.

difficulty.why: I died to a cake. I also got stuck below the well with no clear way to fix it.

interestingness.why: A faithful Zork II setting with new touches in the descriptions.
